usbPowerReview.pdu: Manual prints shared5Vdc/3A20W MAX. 5V times3A is15W; printed rating inconsistent. Individual-port allocation unverified.
usbPowerReview.pi: Pi 400: 5 V / 3 A; official supply 5.1 V / 3 A. Keep matching supply until a dedicated PDU output is verified.
usbPowerReview.smartthings: Reported5V2A. USB-to-barrel may work with verified barrel size/polarity and dedicated2A output. Hub USB-A is not the input.
usbPowerReview.sonoff: NAS USB data and power remain together; never move to charging-only PDU.
